main.description: Period-aggregate attestation of an IN-KIND COMPUTE donation: compute/storage contributed to the Murakumo mesh + kotoba substrate by a donated node. Per ADR-2606012100. Non-titheable (no USDC to split — ADR-2605192130 §5); imputed-value accounted by toritate (ADR-2605262900) for transparency only, never as adherent cash (N1 untouched, ADR-2605301020). Aggregate-only, no donor PII (G7).

period.description: Reporting period this aggregate covers, e.g. '2027-Q1'. Per-node, per-period figure; never per-session real-time (anti-tracking).

nodeClass.description: Donated-node form per ADR-2606012100 §3: ameno = browser WebGPU/WebNN inference (frozen baien edge models); e7m = e7m CLI Ollama/WASM node; kotoba = kotoba pod (IPFS block backend + Datom replication + optional Ollama).

donorDid.description: Optional. Donor DID or ephemeral node DID (donor-held key per ADR-2605231525). MAY be omitted for fully anonymous browser contribution. NEVER a server-held credential.

imputedValueUsdMicros.description: Market-equivalent imputed value of the contributed compute/storage in USD micros (×1e6), method-versioned + Council-attested (ADR-2605301020 §4 method, applied to inbound in-kind). For TRANSPARENCY ONLY — no USDC ever moves on this record.

valuationMethod.description: Versioned valuation-table id, e.g. 'v1-gpu-equiv-hour'. Disclosed open-source so the imputed figure is auditable.

inferenceTokensServed.description: Optional. Inference tokens served to the Murakumo mesh during the period (ameno/e7m/kotoba-with-Ollama).

gpuEquivHoursCenti.description: Optional. GPU-equivalent compute contributed, in centi-hours (×100; no float per ADR-2605190900).

storageGbDays.description: Optional. Substrate durability contributed (kotoba pod): GB·days of pinned blocks / Datom replication during the period.

titheable.description: INVARIANT false: in-kind compute moves no USDC, so the 10% TitheRouter split is N/A (same structural reason as kisha, ADR-2605192130 §5). 100% serves the mission directly.

compensatedUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT 0: compute donation is an UNCOMPENSATED gift. Paying the donor would be commercial GPU rental (Charter Rider §2(i)) — prohibited (G2). Its presence at const 0 is the on-chain proof that no compute marketplace exists.

grantsBenefit.description: INVARIANT false: compute donation is NEVER a path to Liberation-stage advancement, benefits, or priority (anti-class G4; ADR-2605261000 N2/N3; ADR-2605301020 §7).

bestEffort.description: INVARIANT true: donated capacity is best-effort, never an SLA; core-fleet sizing never assumes it (G9).
